text: {"lessons":["A few months of price changes are not enough to justify frequent trades; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","My account fell about 3.4% in one month, a reminder that stocks can swing even when I do nothing; I should keep risk modest to protect savings I rely on.","I should review my holdings and cash against my need for stability, and make deliberate decisions rather than assume holding unchanged is always right."]}
